title: ChatGPT Receives a Major Update! Edit Google Drive Files Directly Without Switching

content_html:
ChatGPT has received a series of practical updates, with the most notable being that subscribed users can now directly add files from Google Drive to their library and complete document editing during conversations.

According to OpenAI's latest feature update, users can simply click the "+" button next to the chat input box, select "Add from Library," and import files from Google Drive into ChatGPT. The AI can then use these files as context to answer questions, generate content summaries, or perform editing tasks. This improvement allows users to avoid the tedious process of frequently switching between ChatGPT and Google Drive, enabling most processing tasks to be completed efficiently within a single interface.

In addition to the direct editing capability for cloud storage files, ChatGPT has also launched a new interactive quiz tool this week, which can automatically generate multiple-choice questions based on user-defined topics. At the same time, the platform has integrated with Yelp, a well-known restaurant review software in the United States, offering convenient services such as restaurant reservations for paid users, bringing more high-quality restaurant recommendations directly to the homepage.

content_html_zh:
ChatGPT 获得了一系列实用更新，其中最引人注目的是订阅用户现在可以直接将 Google Drive 中的文件添加到其库中，并在对话期间完成文档编辑。

根据OpenAI的最新功能更新，用户只需点击聊天输入框旁边的“+”按钮，选择“从库添加”，即可将文件从Google Drive导入ChatGPT。 然后，人工智能可以使用这些文件作为上下文来回答问题、生成内容摘要或执行编辑任务。 这一改进让用户避免了在 ChatGPT 和 Google Drive 之间频繁切换的繁琐过程，使得大多数处理任务能够在单一界面内高效完成。

除了云存储文件的直接编辑功能外，ChatGPT 本周还推出了新的交互式测验工具，该工具可以根据用户定义的主题自动生成多项选择题。 同时，平台与美国知名餐厅点评软件Yelp集成，为付费用户提供餐厅预订等便捷服务，将更多优质餐厅推荐直接带到首页。
